candidates.violated_requirement: The count increment in odd mode is increased by 2 instead of 1, causing the counter to advance too quickly and produce incorrect output timing.
candidates.spec_basis: Count becomes 0 when count == (mode ? div_o : div_e)-1; otherwise (count+1) modulo 16

candidates.violated_requirement: The threshold for setting clk_out_r in even mode is changed from div_e/4+1 to div_e/2+1, causing the output to stay high for too many cycles.
candidates.spec_basis: Output becomes 1 iff count <= floor((mode ? div_o : div_e)/4) + 1

candidates.violated_requirement: Removing the c89-1 condition prevents toggling at the 8/9 switching point, causing incorrect mode transitions.
candidates.spec_basis: Mode toggles iff cycle_count equals M_N-1 or c89-1; otherwise it holds
